description: This file is an initialization module for the image generation subpackage within the llms.xinference package. It imports and exposes specific configuration classes related to image generation transformations, particularly XInferenceImageGenerationConfig, and defines a function to instantiate this configuration.

classes.name: XInferenceImageGenerationConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for XInference image generation, imported from the transformation module.

methods.name: BaseImageGenerationConfig get_xinference_image_generation_config(model: str)
methods.description: Returns an instance of XInferenceImageGenerationConfig initialized for a specified model.
